desc: Since 1979, Kimber Manufacturing has been trusted as a hallmark for superior quality in manufacturing, durability, and accuracy. For 2024, Kimber is celebrating its 45th anniversary. And what better way to commemorate this than to create a unique example of the Raptor, one of the most recognized production Kimber firearms in the last century. It features a custom-coated TiN barrel, distressed slide, hand-finished components, and custom black buffalo horn grips. Limited to a production run of 2024 units, the 45th Anniversary Kimber 1911 will be a cornerstone to any Kimber collection.
